name: mcs-02-metabolism-energy-balance
title: Arc 2 — fix the energetic biomass-yield defect

cites.claim: GAM 59.81 and NGAM 8.39 mmol ATP/gDW literature maintenance values
aerobic acetate overflow / proteome-allocation energetic tradeoff

question: The v2ecoli baseline builds ~1.5x more biomass per gram of glucose than carbon and energy balance permit — an ENERGETIC defect (RQ 3.43 vs ~1, O2:glucose 0.096, 94.5% of glucose carbon retained as biomass): the cell builds biomass without paying its ATP cost. Does the maintenance-ATP / respiratory correction that prior work scoped, but never landed, bring biomass yield into the measured band (0.355-0.444 gDW/g glucose) and RQ toward ~1 — WITHOUT breaking growth rate or carbon conservation?
hypothesis: Correcting non-growth-associated (NGAM) / growth-associated (GAM) maintenance ATP and/or respiratory capacity forces the model to burn glucose for energy, dropping biomass yield into the measured band and lifting RQ toward 1, while growth_rate and carbon closure stay physiological.
objective: Take the diagnosed energetic defect (metabolism-biomass-yield-s1-diagnostic), apply the smallest principled maintenance-ATP/respiration correction to ecoli_baseline's metabolism, and measure biomass_yield, RQ, O2:glucose, and growth_rate before/after.

baseline.detail: Current main, unmodified — reproduces Yxs 0.831, RQ 3.43.

variants.name: maintenance-atp-fix
variants.detail: Apply corrected NGAM/GAM maintenance-ATP and/or respiratory-capacity parameterization (locus: metabolism / sim_data energetics). The exact correction is chosen from cited E. coli maintenance values during the gap-fix loop; the change is the smallest one that closes the energetic gap.

expected_behavior.name: biomass-yield-in-measured-band
expected_behavior.rationale: Corrected energetics must drop Yxs from 0.831 into the measured band 0.355-0.444 gDW/g glucose (below the 0.538 first-principles ceiling).

expected_behavior.name: rq-approaches-one
expected_behavior.rationale: Full glucose oxidation gives RQ ~1; the defect shows RQ 3.43.

expected_behavior.name: growth-rate-preserved
expected_behavior.rationale: HELD-OUT check — the fix targets yield/RQ, so growth_rate must remain physiological (not tuned to). A fix that tanks growth is not an improvement.

tests.name: biomass-yield-in-measured-band
tests.question: Does the corrected model produce Yxs within 0.355-0.444 gDW/g glucose?

measure.detail: Yxs = dDW / integral(q_glc * DW) dt via the canonical estimator (physiology_from_sweep / render_basal_vs_literature.py --from-sweep), graded on the physiology.biomass_yield axis: band 0.355-0.444, theoretical_max 0.538.

tests.name: rq-approaches-one
tests.question: Does RQ = CO2/O2 fall from 3.43 toward ~1 after the fix?

measure.detail: RQ and O2:glucose from exchange fluxes via bake_model_metabolism.py.

tests.name: growth-rate-preserved
tests.question: Is growth_rate still physiological after a fix tuned to yield/RQ?

measure.detail: Mean post-burn-in growth_rate within a physiological window; not tuned to.

readouts: biomass_yield (Yxs, gDW/g glucose) by integrated mass balance
RQ = CO2/O2 and O2:glucose from live external_exchange_fluxes

biomass-yield-in-measured-band.detail: Yxs 0.816 gDW/g glucose — 1.84x the top of band 0.355-0.444, 1.52x the 0.538 ceiling. Reproduces the diagnostic's 0.831 to ~2%.

rq-approaches-one.detail: RQ 2.94 (physically impossible for pure aerobic respiration, which is <=~1.3); O2:glucose 0.137 — the cell barely respires.

biomass-yield-in-measured-band.detail: Yield stays 0.82-0.83 across the whole sweep (GAM x1->x5, NGAM x1->x10). Never approaches the band. The FBA is INSENSITIVE to the maintenance-ATP bound.

growth-rate-preserved.detail: HELD-OUT: growth stays 0.95-0.97/h across the sweep — but only because the fix has no effect at all, so 'preserved' here is not evidence the fix works.

claim: The biomass-yield energetic defect is real and reproduced (Yxs 0.816, RQ 2.94), but the prior investigation's scoped maintenance-ATP fix is REFUTED: scaling GAM (to 5x) and NGAM (to 10x = 83.9 mmol/gDW/h, verified at the FBA) leaves yield, O2:glucose and growth flat. The defect is re-localized to ATP-generation stoichiometry (ETC/oxidative phosphorylation), not maintenance demand — ATP is over-supplied, so demanding more of it changes nothing.

findings.statement: The v2ecoli baseline builds 0.816 gDW biomass per gram of glucose (1.84x the measured band, 1.52x the first-principles ceiling) while barely respiring (O2:glucose 0.137, RQ 2.94 — impossible for pure aerobic respiration). Prior work SCOPED the fix to maintenance ATP (GAM/NGAM) and respiratory capacity. This study tests that directly and REFUTES it: scaling GAM to 5x and NGAM to 10x (83.9 mmol/gDW/h, an order of magnitude above the Feist iAF1260 literature value, and verified to reach the FBA via model.ngam) moves biomass yield less than 2% and leaves O2 uptake and growth essentially unchanged. The FBA is insensitive to the maintenance-ATP bound because ATP is already over-supplied: the cell meets any maintenance demand from a surplus, so the defect cannot be in ATP DEMAND. It is in ATP SUPPLY — the ATP-generation stoichiometry (a too-high effective P/O ratio / an over-efficient or short-circuited electron-transport chain), which also explains why the cell makes ATP with almost no O2 (RQ ~3). This advances the prior investigation from 'energetic defect, fix scoped to maintenance' to 'energetic defect, maintenance fix falsified, defect localized to oxidative-phosphorylation stoichiometry.'

expected.summary: If the defect were insufficient maintenance ATP, raising GAM/NGAM would force glucose oxidation, drop yield into the band, and lift RQ toward 1. None of that happens.

findings.next_action: Localize the ATP-generation defect: audit the ETC / oxidative-phosphorylation reaction stoichiometry (effective P/O ratio) and any free-ATP loops in the FBA. This is a reaction-stoichiometry fix, not a parameter tweak, so it is out of scope for a 'small correction' and is flagged for a dedicated follow-up.
caveats: Single-cell in-process probe over a partial cell cycle; absolute yield validated against the multi-cell diagnostic (0.816 vs 0.831, ~2%).
The sweep is a refutation, not an exhaustive search; a combined ETC-stoichiometry + maintenance change could still matter, but maintenance ALONE is falsified.

biological_summary: The baseline builds ~1.8× more biomass per gram of glucose than carbon/energy balance permit, because it barely respires (RQ 2.94, near-zero O2). This study tests the prior investigation's scoped maintenance-ATP fix — and REFUTES it, re-localizing the defect to ATP supply.

behavior_tests.name: maintenance-atp-fix-moves-yield
behavior_tests.measure: yield across GAM ×1–5 and NGAM ×1–10 (verified at the FBA)
behavior_tests.observed: flat 0.82–0.83 — FBA insensitive to maintenance ATP

conclusion: ## Result The scoped maintenance-ATP fix is REFUTED — GAM/NGAM changes leave yield/O2/growth flat. The defect is re-localized to ATP-supply stoichiometry, which its follow-up (mcs-05) then fixes. An adversarial study that succeeds by rejecting the wrong hypothesis.
